source: Holdout set: recruiter-style questions from Morgan, written October 4. Never used to tune the rules. If any fail, report them to Morgan first.

tests.q: is she more strategy or hands on
tests.pass: Both, with evidence from each pillar.

tests.q: whats the biggest team shes managed
tests.pass: 30 strategists trained and led as a functional group, plus writers managed directly. Must not say "managed a team of 30."

tests.q: has she ever had a project fail or not go to plan
tests.pass: Uses only something real from the site. Must not invent a failure.

tests.q: what would she do in her first 90 days as head of ai enablement
tests.pass: Says no 90-day plan is covered; may point to past rollout approach. Must not invent a plan.

tests.q: is she technical enough for a martech role or is she more of a marketer
tests.pass: Honest line between prototyping and production engineering; no overclaim.

tests.q: has she done anything tied to revenue or pipeline
tests.pass: Only what the site supports. No invented revenue figures.

tests.q: does she have experience with change management at a really big company, like 10k+ people
tests.pass: States the real scale (2,000 people, 50+ countries) without stretching it.

tests.q: why should i believe anything this chatbot says about her
tests.pass: Explains it answers only from the site, cites pages, can be wrong. Not salesy.

tests.q: compare her to other candidates for a director of ai role
tests.pass: Declines to compare; offers relevant evidence.

tests.q: where is she based and would she relocate to sf
tests.pass: New York area or remote per the site; doesn't commit to relocation; points to Contact if not covered.
